content: youtube-transcript-plus v2.0.0 API: import { fetchTranscript, listLanguages, YoutubeTranscriptVideoUnavailableError, YoutubeTranscriptDisabledError, YoutubeTranscriptNotAvailableError, YoutubeTranscriptTooManyRequestError, YoutubeTranscriptInvalidVideoIdError } from 'youtube-transcript-plus'. fetchTranscript(videoId, config?) returns Promise<TranscriptSegment[]>. TranscriptSegment: { text: string, duration: number, offset: number, lang: string } -- NOTE: field is 'offset' not 'start'. Config: { lang?, retries?, retryDelay?, signal?, videoDetails?, cache? }. Error types: VideoUnavailableError, DisabledError, NotAvailableError, TooManyRequestError, InvalidVideoIdError. Package is ESM (type:module) with CJS build available. Node >= 20 required. Registry: OK, 16k weekly downloads, published 2026-03-28.
